subject.title: fix(agents): terminate mixed tool-call batches on critical loop veto

question: Must this PR demonstrate the production `createAgentSession` plus real loop-detector path before it can become the canonical fix over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106297?
rationale: The patch design is sound and follows the upstream contract, but only an owner can accept or override the missing production-path proof while choosing between two overlapping candidates.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Require redacted runtime output covering the real critical detector, completed sibling tool, terminal transcript, queued-input outcome, and absence of another provider turn before selecting this PR.

options.title: Accept controlled Agent proof
options.body: Apply a proof override and select this branch based on its Agent orchestration transcript plus focused coverage, accepting that the detector and provider path remain synthetic.

options.title: Select the competing candidate
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106297 only if its refreshed head supplies stronger production proof or a clearly better permanent owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted runtime output covering the real critical detector, completed sibling tool, terminal transcript, queued-input outcome, and absence of another provider turn before selecting this PR.
